# GitHub release management — swarm-orchestrated release pipelines

Curated by Skill Harbor — @ruvnet's release management skill (Claude Flow team): it orchestrates the full release pipeline — semver analysis with breaking-change detection from commits, changelog generation, automated testing, multi-target deployment (npm, Docker, GitHub) and rollback management, starting from a draft-first `gh release create` quick start. Honest caveats: requires the gh CLI and claude-flow (ruv-swarm optional) installed; releases touch production artifacts — the skill's own steps keep draft-first and confirmation-first flows, keep it that way and never let it auto-publish a release you have not approved. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
